'''Jag Murrock''' was an accomplished [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Way of the Force" />

==Biography==
===Early travels===
Jag would often been seen [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] his aging [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Hardly Worth Stealing]]''. He was a well-traveled man who went on long voyages exploring unknown areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. On one such excursion, during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he came across the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was here, on several of the larger [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], that he discovered a large quantity of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. He later extracted the lodes using his profound knowledge of [[Mining/Legends|mining]].<ref name="The Way of the Force" />

===Helping a Jedi Master===
Seeing as these Adegan [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were commonly used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction, Jag agreed to supply them to the [[Almas Academy]] on [[Almas]]. He also agreed to help [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] in a training mission for a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Qel-Bertuk sent the Jedi off to obtain the Adegan crystals on Jag's asteroid, but they were ambushed by Jag, who was posing as an independent miner. This was all part of a plan to teach the Padawan learners, who were nearby on the asteroid, how to act in difficult situations. Jag fired several warning [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots into the air, and accused the Jedi of stealing his claim. Being an expert in Zero-G maneuvering, Jag threatened to defend his crystals at all costs. He later accepted a hefty sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] in return for the crystals. After the training mission had ended, Jag repaid the credits to the Jedi.<ref name="The Way of the Force" />

====Revelation====
Both Jag and Master Qel-Bertuk sensed something wrong with some of the crystals, and they believed that they had been somehow changed after the destruction of [[Oblis]] nearly [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 years earlier]]. Later on, Jag was unhappy to discover that the Adegan crystal remains were finally depleted.<ref name="The Way of the Force" />
